407:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even I can't think of any comforting words this time. So I'll be taking a break from congratulating our ace pilots, too.」

407:t_10:25.en:
$$シェリル$$
「That's fine. Let's trust them for now instead of fumbling for words.」

407:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're right. Then I'll do what I can.」

407:t_10:27.en:
$$シェリル$$
「That's fine, but keep it low-key today.」

407:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I understand. I'll quietly... get down to business today.」

407:t_10:29.en:
$$シェリル$$
(I believe in you, $$アルト$$. I know you and the others will save both $$ランカ$$-chan and $$エイミー$$.)

407:t_10:30.en:
$$シェリル$$
(Cut through that fog with your wings.)

408:t_000:0.en:
$$オズマ$$
「So $$アルト$$ and $$ブレラ$$ are teaming up...」

408:t_000:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Maybe that's his way of giving $$ランカ$$ a little help.」

408:t_000:4.en:
$$宗介$$
(Major $$オズマ$$ is pretty detached about $$アルト$$'s love triangle.)

408:t_000:5.en:
$$キラ$$
(He used to be very wary of any man who got close to $$ランカ$$.)

408:t_000:6.en:
$$シン$$
(That's fine, isn't it? It's only natural for a big brother to worry about his little sister.)

408:t_000:11.en:
$$オズマ$$
「All units, they're coming! Prepare to intercept!」

408:t_001:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That machine...! Is that $$ギルター・ベローネ$$?!」

408:t_001:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「What do I care about that?!」

408:t_001:4.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Because of you, I was shunted off to a dead-end post in this backwater!」

408:t_001:5.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I'll defeat you here and make my glorious return to the front lines!」

408:t_001:6.en:
$$葵$$
「You really are pathetic through and through.」

408:t_001:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We have no intention of being your stepping stone to a promotion!」

408:t_001:8.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, engage. We'll defeat them here and clear $$サイデリアル$$ out of the $$残されの海$$.」

408:t_001:9.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
(Fleet Commander $$フェアロック$$... I'll put one of your worries to rest here.)

408:t_001:10.en:
$$アルト$$
「Don't bring your twisted logic into this sea! Let's settle this already!」

408:t_002:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「You blasted pests...! Why do you keep resisting $$サイデリアル$$?!」

408:t_002:1.en:
$$赤木$$
「What are you talking about?! We're resisting because you attacked us!」

408:t_002:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「We love freedom and peace. If you want to take them away, we'll fight you as much as you like.」

408:t_002:3.en:
$$ギルター$$
「You never stop mouthing off!」

408:t_004:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Damn it, more interlopers! I'm leaving!」

408:t_005:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「We have to deal with the $$バジュラ$$ first!」

408:t_005:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「But their colors are different from the ones we know!」

408:t_005:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「And the unmanned fighters the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ used are here, too!」

408:t_005:4.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Be careful! It looks like those $$バジュラ$$ are part of the $$ギャラクシー船団$$'s forces!」

408:t_005:6.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「It seems they've developed technology to control the $$バジュラ$$.」

408:t_005:7.en:
$$葵$$
「I can't believe they can do that...!」

408:t_005:8.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Could that be what changed their coloration?」

408:t_007:0.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「$$アンタレス１$$, I understand.」

408:t_010:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ブレラ$$! Are they controlling you again?!」

408:t_010:2.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I am $$アンタレス１$$. I am a soldier of the $$ギャラクシー船団$$.」

408:t_014:1.en:
$$カナリア$$
「$$ブレラ$$ originally belonged to the $$ギャラクシー船団$$. He underwent $$インプラント$$ surgery there.」

408:t_014:2.en:
$$カナリア$$
「They probably installed a mind-control system at the same time.」

408:t_014:3.en:
$$クラン$$
「But wasn't that supposed to have been destroyed when $$アルト$$ shot him down during the $$再世戦争$$...?!」

408:t_014:4.en:
$$ルカ$$
「I believe they had a backup system... or a stronger control link prepared for emergencies.」

408:t_014:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「What will you do, Captain $$ジェフリー$$?」

408:t_014:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The $$ギャラクシー船団$$ and $$サイデリアル$$ don't appear to be cooperating, but both are targeting us.」

408:t_014:7.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「At this rate, we'll be caught in a pincer attack...!」

408:t_014:8.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, intercept the $$バジュラ$$. As for $$ブレラ・スターン$$, try to disable him if at all possible.」

408:t_014:11.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$レド$$... I'll ask what happened to you later. Right now, I need your help.」

408:t_014:12.en:
$$レド$$
「Are we going to defeat that man?」

408:t_014:13.en:
$$アルト$$
「No...! We're going to stop him... for $$ランカ$$'s sake, too!」

408:t_014:14.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Let's do our best, $$バサラ$$! Our songs can reach those $$バジュラ$$, too!」
